label: Bible Study
prompt: For unto us a child is born, unto us a son is given: and the _____ shall be upon his shoulder: and his name shall be called Wonderful, Counsellor, The mighty God, The everlasting Father, The Prince of Peace.
verse: For unto us a child is born, unto us a son is given: and the government shall be upon his shoulder: and his name shall be called Wonderful, Counsellor, The mighty God, The everlasting Father, The Prince of Peace.
note: Handel set this one to music — the Christmas prophecy, seven hundred years early.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: It is of the LORD'S _____ that we are not consumed, because his compassions fail not.
verse: It is of the LORD'S mercies that we are not consumed, because his compassions fail not.
note: A verse about not being consumed, written in a book called Lamentations — hope in the ashes.

label: Sunday School
prompt: I will praise thee; for I am _____ and wonderfully made: marvellous are thy works; and that my soul knoweth right well.
verse: I will praise thee; for I am fearfully and wonderfully made: marvellous are thy works; and that my soul knoweth right well.
note: 'Fearfully and wonderfully made' — fearfully here means awe, not anxiety.

label: Deep Water
prompt: A word fitly spoken is like _____ of gold in pictures of silver.
verse: A word fitly spoken is like apples of gold in pictures of silver.
note: The right word at the right moment is jewelry — 'pictures' here means settings of silver.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: In my Father's house are many _____: if it were not so, I would have told you. I go to prepare a place for you.
verse: In my Father's house are many mansions: if it were not so, I would have told you. I go to prepare a place for you.
note: 'Mansions' from the Latin mansio — a dwelling place. The KJV made heaven's real estate famous.
